sourceBindings.text: Heavy sweating; pale, cool or clammy skin; headache, nausea, dizziness and weakness.
Very hot body; skin may look flushed; confusion or unusual behaviour; possible seizure or unconsciousness; rapid pulse may occur.
Dry skin OR continued heavy sweating. Sweating does not rule it out.
Stop activity; cool and observe; small sips only if fully alert and swallowing safely; arrange medical assessment.
Call 123; begin rapid cooling and stay with the person while following trained emergency guidance.
Confusion, collapse or worsening condition requires urgent emergency help.
Do not wait for sweating to stop or for every listed symptom to appear.
